items.text: NY Jets (early week): Geno Smith played through his ankle sprain in the Wk11 win, starts. WR Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle/hip) in doubt, WR Isaiah Williams (ribs) uncertain; DT David Onyemata expected back from IR.
Miami (early week): CB JuJu Brents (shoulder) day-to-day; G Jonah Savaiinaea and WR Chris Bell OK. IR - QB Malik Willis, RB De'Von Achane (season). Kyle McCord starts.
